name: Alfred Arrowsmith
original_name: アルフレッド・アロースミス
source:
The cold-hearted, emotionless, and merciless brother of Rick. Wields a magical gun called the Dead Ones' Touching Finger, also known as Luda Grefind. He lost his arm while saving his mother and has a prothesis instead of it. He lost his parents due to a bloody accident, which resulted in him losing "affection" and having an endless void inside his heart, which will cause many woes in the future.

Alfred was separated from his brother soon after they were taken in by the Fortenmayer family, as he was taken by Sid, who saw the very same darkness in Alfred's eyes as he had. Having the means to live, he had no personal goal in life, nor even an attachment to living itself.

He does not distinguish between justice and injustice, good and bad, right and evil, and therefore finds the "right" in the will of one whom he serves. He carries out his master's darkest desires, even if they were not spoken, sometimes unbeknownst to the master himself, even if they intended to manipulate, twist fates, plunge in the mud, or even kill children, lovers, and old men all over the world.

[spoiler]He believes he cannot progress without settling the score with his brother Rick, whom he has grown to envy for his ability to feel positive emotions and affection. Alfred's actions brought collapse to endless souls and even his master Sid, even if he could be saved, for it was his long-harbored desire in the bottom of his heart. He is the one who turned him down the path of self-destruction. [i]The path, which brought endless griefs to countless living beings...[/i][/spoiler]
